verdict.rationale: Bento has no dedicated sandbox mode, but its docs explicitly recommend separate Sites for 'Production and testing', with data isolated between Sites in one account. That gives an AI-native user a workaround test environment, and Bento Skills adds agent safety guidance for live account operations. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test mode, test API keys or simulated sends that never deliver real email, documentation of how agents (MCP/CLI) target a test Site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
